Per assistenza, chiarimenti su contenuti: For help, questions about the learning content or technical reports about the platform:
<strong>Orari indicativi di risposta:</s: Typical response times: 2–5 working days for standard requests; for urgent issues involving a compromised account, say so in the subject line.
Il messaggio arriva al team su <strong>s: Your message reaches the team at support@projectevil.it and we reply to the address you give. If you are signed in, you also receive a confirmation email.
Su quale pagina o strumento? Cosa stavi: Which page or tool? What were you doing and what happened?
Cosa scrivere nella richiesta: What to include in your request
Per aiutarti in modo rapido, includi:: To help us help you quickly, include:
Indirizzo email usato per l'account EVIL: The email address you use for your EVIL account (if relevant).
Pagina o strumento (es. Lab virtuale, Ch: The page or tool (e.g. Virtual lab, URL check, Quiz centre).
Descrizione del problema o del concetto: A description of the problem or of the concept you want clarified.
Browser e dispositivo (es. Chrome su Win: Browser and device (e.g. Chrome on Windows, Safari on iPhone), if the problem concerns the layout or a button.
Il testo esatto dell'eventuale messaggio: The exact text of any error message. To send a screenshot, write directly to support@projectevil.it.
Spiegazioni su quiz, lab, simulatori e p: Explanations of quizzes, labs, simulators and learning paths.
Problemi di registrazione, login, verifi: Problems with sign-up, sign-in, email verification or password recovery.
Funzionamento degli strumenti di analisi: How the analysis tools work in an authorised, defensive context.
Segnalazioni di bug o contenuti errati n: Reports of bugs or incorrect content on the platform.
<strong>Non forniamo supporto</strong> p: We do not provide support for offensive activities, bypassing security on third-party systems or using the tools without authorisation. See also the site policies.
Verifica email non arriva: The verification email does not arrive
In locale, senza SMTP configurato, il li: Locally, without SMTP configured, the link may be in the project outbox (data/email-outbox). With Mailtrap Sandbox the email stays in the Mailtrap inbox, not in Gmail.
Pagina senza stili o login non funziona: The page has no styles or sign-in does not work
In locale apri <strong>http://localhost:: Locally, open http://localhost:5000 after npm start, not the HTML file from disk.
Online, always use the same domain (e.g. only www or only the apex), set BASE_URL and COOKIE_DOMAIN=.yourdomain.com in production, and verify your email before signing in for the first time.
Lab Virtuale: «Avvia VM» non risponde: Virtual lab: the scenario does not start
Il lab usa le API <code>/api/virtual-lab: The lab uses the /api/virtual-lab/* APIs on the same domain. In production you need TRUST_PROXY=1 and, with several instances, REDIS_URL for sessions. A red message under the card shows the error details (session limit, network, etc.).
In <strong>locale</strong>, <code>http:/: Locally, http://localhost has no TLS certificate: Edge flags it, but that is normal for development.
In <strong>produzione</strong> apri solo: In production open only https:// on the domain with an active certificate (Render/Railway: enable TLS on the custom domain). Set NODE_ENV=production, BASE_URL=https://www.yourdomain.com, TRUST_PROXY=1 and FORCE_HTTPS=1. Do not mix www and the domain without www if the certificate covers only one host.
Progressi o account diversi tra PC: Different progress or accounts on different PCs
In sviluppo locale i dati sono sul file: In local development the data lives in that computer's users.json file; it does not sync with production.
